# Brikly

> Construction management software designed for small to medium-sized contractors in the United States. Real-time job costing, mobile crew tracking, and OSHA compliance without enterprise complexity.

## About
Brikly is a B2B SaaS construction management platform that helps small-to-medium contractors (1-50 employees) manage projects, track costs, and stay compliant. Founded in 2024, Brikly serves over 500 contractors across residential, commercial, and specialty trades. The platform costs $350/month with unlimited users — no per-seat fees, no setup costs, no long-term contracts.

## Key Features
- Real-Time Job Costing: Track labor, materials, equipment, and subcontractor costs against budgets in real-time with profit margin alerts
- Mobile Crew Tracking: Native iOS and Android apps with GPS time tracking, geofencing, photo documentation, and offline capability
- Project Scheduling: Gantt charts, resource planning, milestone tracking with Google Calendar and Outlook sync
- OSHA Compliance: Digital safety checklists, incident reporting, toolbox talk logging, and automated compliance reports
- QuickBooks Integration: 2-way sync for invoices, expenses, vendor bills, and financial reconciliation
- Change Order Management: Digital approval workflows, cost impact calculations, client e-signatures, and audit trails
- Client Portal: Homeowners and clients view project progress, photos, schedules, and invoices in real-time
- Daily Reports: Standardized progress tracking with photo attachments and automatic distribution
- Document Management: Centralized document storage with version control and categorization
- Subcontractor Management: Track contracts, insurance certificates, lien waivers, and coordinate schedules
- Estimate Templates: Reusable estimate templates with line item library for consistent bidding
- GPS Time Tracking: Geofenced clock in/out with location verification for accurate payroll

## Pricing
- $350/month flat rate with unlimited users and all features
- 14-day free trial, no credit card required
- No setup fees, no per-user charges, no hidden costs
- Annual plan: $3,570/year (save 15%)
- Enterprise pricing available for organizations with 50+ employees

## Target Audience
- Small to medium construction contractors (1-50 employees)
- General contractors managing residential and commercial projects
- Specialty contractors: plumbing, HVAC, electrical, roofing, painting
- Project managers and field supervisors
- Construction business owners seeking affordable alternatives to Procore and Buildertrend

## Competitive Positioning
Brikly is the affordable alternative to enterprise construction software:
- vs Procore: 50% less cost ($350 vs $500+/month), implements in days vs months, unlimited users included
- vs Buildertrend: Lower cost ($350 vs $399+/month), serves all trades (not just residential), unlimited users
- vs CoConstruct: More features for commercial and specialty trades, better job costing capabilities
- Key advantages: Fastest implementation (1-2 days), no per-seat pricing, purpose-built for SMB contractors

## Success Metrics
- 500+ contractors using the platform
- Average customer saves $50,000+ annually
- 23% average reduction in project costs
- 98% customer retention rate
- 4.8/5 star rating from 247 verified reviews
- 50% faster project setup compared to competitors
- 95% customer satisfaction rate

## Technical Details
- Platform: Cloud-based SaaS (Cloudflare global CDN)
- Mobile: Native iOS and Android apps with offline capability
- Integrations: QuickBooks Online, Google Calendar, Microsoft Outlook
- Security: SOC2 compliant, GDPR compliant, encrypted data at rest and in transit
- Uptime: 99.9% availability SLA
- Data: Real-time sync across all devices
